dialogues.speaker: Raduzhnaya
dialogues.text: Welcome to the House of Hesperides! I'm Ksenia, receptionist at the front hall. If there's anything I can do for you, dear guest, simply say the word!

dialogues.speaker: Oksana
dialogues.text: Hmm... sure! I'll give you the introduction right away. Hehe, I don't do this much. I might be a bit nervous...

dialogues.speaker: Oksana
dialogues.text: This place is the House of Hesperides. It was built here by the first Grand Duke of the Snegovik after the Belyi Tsar unified the north and set up the Pale Star court...

dialogues.speaker: Oksana
dialogues.text: Thousands of years have passed since then, and the person in the seat of the Grand Duchy has changed several times...

dialogues.speaker: Oksana
dialogues.text: But thanks to our hard work in maintaining it, this mansion still retains the look it had when it was first built!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't need anything right now, thanks.
